config.neo4j.topic.cypher.dbserver.public.stude: MERGE (s:Student {id: event.id}) SET s.student_card_number = event.student_card_number WITH s MATCH (g:StudentGroup {id: event.group_id}) MERGE (g)-[:HAS_STUDENT]->(s)
config.neo4j.topic.cypher.dbserver.public.lectu: MERGE (l:Lecture {id: event.id}) SET l.type = event.lecture_type, l.title = event.title
config.neo4j.topic.cypher.dbserver.public.sched: MERGE (sch:Schedule {id: event.id}) SET sch.date = event.scheduled_date, sch.classroom = event.classroom, sch.time = event.start_time WITH sch MATCH (g:StudentGroup {id: event.group_id}) MATCH (l:Lecture {id: event.lecture_id}) MERGE (g)-[:HAS_SCHEDULE]->(sch) MERGE (sch)-[:PART_OF]->(l)
